findings.label: same-author WRITTEN reasoning, unfiled
findings.content: Every RSNB band satisfies xyxzxy=xzxy, and this identity characterizes RSNB. Therefore the image semigroupoid of the graph e:c->c', x,y:c'->c inside ANY non-RSNB band has RSNB local semigroups (they are 2-generated) but violates a valid RSNB path identity. So RSNB is not local in Tilson's semigroupoid sense, and item4 cannot follow from the local RRL property alone; regularity must be used. Separately: for every RRL regular source and every e with a=ex, b=ey same-fibre idempotents, aba=ba, proved via f=ee' and the RRB local band at f. So this particular path identity holds in all RRL sources.
